SET lock_timeout = '5s'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS anchors (
	        id             uuid PRIMARY KEY,
	        kind           text NOT NULL,
	        arch_type      text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        arch_module    text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        fingerprint    text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        root_id        uuid,
	        src            uuid,
	        dst            uuid,
	        undirected     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	        props          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
	        format_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	        updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	        seq            bigserial
	    )

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_src
	        ON anchors (src, arch_type) WHERE src IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_dst
	        ON anchors (dst, arch_type) WHERE dst IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_kind_type
	        ON anchors (kind, arch_type)
ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS src_type text
ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS dst_type text

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_src_typed
	        ON anchors (src, arch_type, dst_type) INCLUDE (dst)
	        WHERE src IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_dst_typed
	        ON anchors (dst, arch_type, src_type) INCLUDE (src)
	        WHERE dst IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_root
	        ON anchors (root_id) WHERE root_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS graph_types (
	        type_name text NOT NULL,
	        ancestor  text NOT NULL,
	        PRIMARY KEY (type_name, ancestor)
	    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kv_state (
	        key        text PRIMARY KEY,
	        value      text NOT NULL,
	        expires_at timestamptz,
	        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
	    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quarantine (
	        missing_id  uuid NOT NULL,
	        referrer_id uuid,
	        kind        text NOT NULL,
	        created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	        PRIMARY KEY (missing_id, kind)
	    )

SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
	                WHERE table_name = 'anchors' AND column_name = 'seq'

UPDATE anchors e SET src_type = n.arch_type
	                  FROM anchors n
	                 WHERE e.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND e.src = n.id
	                   AND e.src IS NOT NULL AND e.src_type IS NULL

UPDATE anchors e SET dst_type = n.arch_type
	                  FROM anchors n
	                 WHERE e.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND e.dst = n.id
	                   AND e.dst IS NOT NULL AND e.dst_type IS NULL

ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS g_customer_c_last text
	                GENERATED ALWAYS AS (props->'archetype'->>'c_last') STORED

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_g_customer_c_last ON anchors (g_customer_c_last)
	                WHERE arch_type = 'Customer'

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $2 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $3 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $4 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $2 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $3 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $4 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

INSERT INTO anchors
	            (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	             src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, updated_at,
	             src_type, dst_type)
	        SELECT id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, $1, now(),
	               src_type, dst_type
	        FROM unnest(
	            CAST($2 AS uuid[]), CAST($3 AS text[]),
	            CAST($4 AS text[]), CAST($5 AS text[]),
	            CAST($6 AS text[]), CAST($7 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($8 AS uuid[]), CAST($9 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($10 AS boolean[]), CAST($11 AS jsonb[]),
	            CAST($12 AS text[]), CAST($13 AS text[])
	        ) AS t(id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, src_type, dst_type)
	        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
	            kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
	            arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
	            arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
	            fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
	            root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
	            src = EXCLUDED.src,
	            dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
	            undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
	            props = EXCLUDED.props,
	            format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
	            updated_at = now(),
	            -- an edge re-saved while its endpoints are unpopulated stubs
	            -- carries NULL types; keep whatever was recorded earlier
	            src_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.src_type, anchors.src_type),
	            dst_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.dst_type, anchors.dst_type)

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))
ROLLBACK
DEALLOCATE ALL
SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id = $1
SHOW server_version_num

SELECT value FROM kv_state
	        WHERE key = $1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
SET lock_timeout = '5s'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS anchors (
	        id             uuid PRIMARY KEY,
	        kind           text NOT NULL,
	        arch_type      text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        arch_module    text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        fingerprint    text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        root_id        uuid,
	        src            uuid,
	        dst            uuid,
	        undirected     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	        props          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
	        format_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	        updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	        seq            bigserial
	    )

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_src
	        ON anchors (src, arch_type) WHERE src IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_dst
	        ON anchors (dst, arch_type) WHERE dst IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_kind_type
	        ON anchors (kind, arch_type)
ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS src_type text
ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS dst_type text

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_src_typed
	        ON anchors (src, arch_type, dst_type) INCLUDE (dst)
	        WHERE src IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_dst_typed
	        ON anchors (dst, arch_type, src_type) INCLUDE (src)
	        WHERE dst IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_root
	        ON anchors (root_id) WHERE root_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS graph_types (
	        type_name text NOT NULL,
	        ancestor  text NOT NULL,
	        PRIMARY KEY (type_name, ancestor)
	    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kv_state (
	        key        text PRIMARY KEY,
	        value      text NOT NULL,
	        expires_at timestamptz,
	        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
	    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quarantine (
	        missing_id  uuid NOT NULL,
	        referrer_id uuid,
	        kind        text NOT NULL,
	        created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	        PRIMARY KEY (missing_id, kind)
	    )

SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
	                WHERE table_name = 'anchors' AND column_name = 'seq'

UPDATE anchors e SET src_type = n.arch_type
	                  FROM anchors n
	                 WHERE e.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND e.src = n.id
	                   AND e.src IS NOT NULL AND e.src_type IS NULL

UPDATE anchors e SET dst_type = n.arch_type
	                  FROM anchors n
	                 WHERE e.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND e.dst = n.id
	                   AND e.dst IS NOT NULL AND e.dst_type IS NULL

ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS g_customer_c_last text
	                GENERATED ALWAYS AS (props->'archetype'->>'c_last') STORED

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_g_customer_c_last ON anchors (g_customer_c_last)
	                WHERE arch_type = 'Customer'

	            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '10s'

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $2 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $3 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $4 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

	             src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, updated_at,
	             src_type, dst_type)
	        SELECT id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, $1, now(),
	               src_type, dst_type
	        FROM unnest(
	            CAST($2 AS uuid[]), CAST($3 AS text[]),
	            CAST($4 AS text[]), CAST($5 AS text[]),
	            CAST($6 AS text[]), CAST($7 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($8 AS uuid[]), CAST($9 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($10 AS boolean[]), CAST($11 AS jsonb[]),
	            CAST($12 AS text[]), CAST($13 AS text[])
	        ) AS t(id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, src_type, dst_type)
	        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
	            kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
	            arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
	            arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
	            fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
	            root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
	            src = EXCLUDED.src,
	            dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
	            undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
	            props = EXCLUDED.props,
	            format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
	            updated_at = now(),
	            -- an edge re-saved while its endpoints are unpopulated stubs
	            -- carries NULL types; keep whatever was recorded earlier
	            src_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.src_type, anchors.src_type),
	            dst_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.dst_type, anchors.dst_type)

SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id = $1
SHOW server_version_num

SELECT value FROM kv_state
	        WHERE key = $1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
SET lock_timeout = '5s'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS anchors (
	        id             uuid PRIMARY KEY,
	        kind           text NOT NULL,
	        arch_type      text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        arch_module    text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        fingerprint    text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	        root_id        uuid,
	        src            uuid,
	        dst            uuid,
	        undirected     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
	        props          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
	        format_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	        updated_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	        seq            bigserial
	    )

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_src
	        ON anchors (src, arch_type) WHERE src IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_dst
	        ON anchors (dst, arch_type) WHERE dst IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_kind_type
	        ON anchors (kind, arch_type)
ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS src_type text
ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS dst_type text

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_src_typed
	        ON anchors (src, arch_type, dst_type) INCLUDE (dst)
	        WHERE src IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_dst_typed
	        ON anchors (dst, arch_type, src_type) INCLUDE (src)
	        WHERE dst IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anchors_root
	        ON anchors (root_id) WHERE root_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS graph_types (
	        type_name text NOT NULL,
	        ancestor  text NOT NULL,
	        PRIMARY KEY (type_name, ancestor)
	    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS kv_state (
	        key        text PRIMARY KEY,
	        value      text NOT NULL,
	        expires_at timestamptz,
	        updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
	    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quarantine (
	        missing_id  uuid NOT NULL,
	        referrer_id uuid,
	        kind        text NOT NULL,
	        created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
	        PRIMARY KEY (missing_id, kind)
	    )

SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
	                WHERE table_name = 'anchors' AND column_name = 'seq'

UPDATE anchors e SET src_type = n.arch_type
	                  FROM anchors n
	                 WHERE e.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND e.src = n.id
	                   AND e.src IS NOT NULL AND e.src_type IS NULL

UPDATE anchors e SET dst_type = n.arch_type
	                  FROM anchors n
	                 WHERE e.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND e.dst = n.id
	                   AND e.dst IS NOT NULL AND e.dst_type IS NULL

ALTER TABLE anchors ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS g_customer_c_last text
	                GENERATED ALWAYS AS (props->'archetype'->>'c_last') STORED

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_g_customer_c_last ON anchors (g_customer_c_last)
	                WHERE arch_type = 'Customer'

INSERT INTO graph_types (type_name, ancestor)
	            SELECT * FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS text[]), CAST($2 AS text[]))
	            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
COMMIT
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '10s'

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = $2 OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = $3 OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $4 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $4)) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

INSERT INTO anchors
	            (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	             src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, updated_at,
	             src_type, dst_type)
	        SELECT id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, $1, now(),
	               src_type, dst_type
	        FROM unnest(
	            CAST($2 AS uuid[]), CAST($3 AS text[]),
	            CAST($4 AS text[]), CAST($5 AS text[]),
	            CAST($6 AS text[]), CAST($7 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($8 AS uuid[]), CAST($9 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($10 AS boolean[]), CAST($11 AS jsonb[]),
	            CAST($12 AS text[]), CAST($13 AS text[])
	        ) AS t(id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, src_type, dst_type)
	        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
	            kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
	            arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
	            arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
	            fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
	            root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
	            src = EXCLUDED.src,
	            dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
	            undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
	            props = EXCLUDED.props,
	            format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
	            updated_at = now(),
	            -- an edge re-saved while its endpoints are unpopulated stubs
	            -- carries NULL types; keep whatever was recorded earlier
	            src_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.src_type, anchors.src_type),
	            dst_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.dst_type, anchors.dst_type)

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

INSERT INTO anchors
	            (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	             src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, updated_at,
	             src_type, dst_type)
	        SELECT id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, $1, now(),
	               src_type, dst_type
	        FROM unnest(
	            CAST($2 AS uuid[]), CAST($3 AS text[]),
	            CAST($4 AS text[]), CAST($5 AS text[]),
	            CAST($6 AS text[]), CAST($7 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($8 AS uuid[]), CAST($9 AS uuid[]),
	            CAST($10 AS boolean[]), CAST($11 AS jsonb[]),
	            CAST($12 AS text[]), CAST($13 AS text[])
	        ) AS t(id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
	               src, dst, undirected, props, src_type, dst_type)
	        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
	            kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
	            arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
	            arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
	            fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
	            root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
	            src = EXCLUDED.src,
	            dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
	            undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
	            props = EXCLUDED.props,
	            format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
	            updated_at = now(),
	            -- an edge re-saved while its endpoints are unpopulated stubs
	            -- carries NULL types; keep whatever was recorded earlier
	            src_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.src_type, anchors.src_type),
	            dst_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.dst_type, anchors.dst_type)
